obligations.summary: Repeated attempts at operation.create_order sharing idempotency_key produce the effects of a single invocation.
assumptions: effect.create_order.publish_created propagates the invocation key into event_id

evidence.subject: tx.create_order.new
evidence.message: keyed commit deduplication makes the insert and both artifact establishments at-most-once per key

evidence.subject: intent.create_order.publish_created
evidence.message: the recovered intent carries the same deterministic contents on every attempt

obligations.summary: Every attempt at operation.create_order sharing the declared key observes an equivalent response.

evidence.subject: result.create_order
evidence.message: established inside the keyed-deduplicated transaction, so retries recover the original artifact instead of recomputing it

obligations.summary: An interrupted invocation of operation.create_order can be resumed to reach a declared flow's terminal step.

evidence.subject: flow.create_order.new
evidence.message: every failure prefix admits a continuation: an uncommitted transaction re-executes, a committed one resolves by key, and the publication intent is replay-available from the commit

obligations.summary: flow.create_order.new reaches its terminal response from every admitted interruption point.

evidence.message: two steps, both re-drivable: keyed transaction then intent execution

evidence.subject: input.reserve_inventory.created
evidence.message: deliveries sharing order_id enter one lane and at most one invocation per lane is active

obligations.summary: Invocations of operation.reserve_inventory sharing order_id take effect in their semantic order.

obligations.summary: Repeated attempts at operation.reserve_inventory sharing event_id produce the effects of a single invocation.

evidence.subject: tx.reserve_inventory
evidence.message: the commit is not deduplicated and the reserved counter is derived from a transaction read, so the body is not naturally replayable

trace.description: tx.reserve_inventory reads reserved=0, writes reserved=2, commits
the delivery acknowledgement is lost before the broker records completion
the same logical message (event_id=E) is redelivered
tx.reserve_inventory reads reserved=2, writes reserved=4: the same event reserves stock twice

obligations.summary: Re-executing tx.reserve_inventory reproduces the original committed outcome.

evidence.message: the write to stock.reserved depends on read.reserve_inventory.stock, whose observed value changes across attempts, including due to the transaction's own prior commit

obligations.summary: An interrupted invocation of operation.reserve_inventory is re-driven until it reaches a declared flow's terminal step.
assumptions: at_least_once delivery on input.reserve_inventory.created acts as the retry driver

evidence.subject: tx.reserve_inventory
evidence.message: resumability cannot be established: the commit is neither deduplicated nor naturally replayable (see the disproven natural-replayability obligation), so a prefix interrupted after commit has no proven route for resolving the transaction on re-encounter
the at_least_once retry driver discharges only the liveness half of guaranteed completion; the resumability half remains undecided
